# Scope: the remaining obfuscated members of com.desertstormfront.world after the TerrainGrid,
# Vec2 and Vec3 batches. Evidence per symbol:
# DijkstraNode (package-private Dijkstra heap node; fields a=x, b=y, c=next, d=cost read directly):
#   the six /* synthetic */ static accessors are the only way SortedNodeQueue and
#   DirectionFieldPathFinder touch it, so they inherit the field semantics:
#   a(DijkstraNode) -> c -> getNext ; b(DijkstraNode) -> d -> getCost ;
#   a(x,y) -> setNext ; a(int) -> setCost ; c -> b -> getY ; d -> a -> getX.
#   Constructors are <init> and are not listed.
# SortedNodeQueue (linked-list priority queue; a=head sentinel, b=count):
#   a() pops the head via DijkstraNode.getNext -> poll ; b() zeroes the count -> clear ;
#   a(node) walks by cost and links -> insert ; b(node) unlinks by identity -> remove ;
# DirectionFieldPathFinder / PathFinder (flow-field builder; TerrainGrid calls it in
#   a(TerrainGridAccessor, ProgressCallback) is the PathFinder build hook -> build ;
#   a(Domain, x1,y1,x2,y2) returns the Neighbor stepping from one tile to the other -> findDirection ;
#   private a(int domainSlot, x,y, fromX,fromY) extracts the 4-bit direction -> readField ;
#   private a(int, x,y, fromX,fromY, direction) packs it back -> writeField.
#   static a() is the javac switch-map accessor (synthetic, no source-level meaning): left unnamed.
# GridCell (package-private cell of TerrainGrid; fields a=RoadTile, b=Site, c=Unit, d=UnitList):
#   getters/setters named after the fields; b(Unit)/c(Unit) are add/remove on the UnitList
#   (used by TerrainGrid.addUnitToTile / removeUnitFromTile) ; e() is site!=null||unit!=null and is
# Neighbor (8-way tile step). The sign convention is fixed by game.model.Direction, which is already
#   semantic: (dx,dy) = (1,0) East, (1,1) NorthEast, (0,1) North, (-1,1) NorthWest, (-1,0) West,
#   (-1,-1) SouthWest, (0,-1) South, (1,-1) SouthEast - i.e. +x is East and +y is North.
#   Constant a is the (MAX_VALUE, MAX_VALUE) sentinel returned for "unreachable"
#   (TerrainGrid.findNeighbor, DirectionFieldPathFinder) -> None ; f=(0,0) is compared against to
#   mean "already there" -> Center ; the other eight map one-to-one onto the Direction names.
#   Methods: a()/b() return dx/dy -> getDx/getDy ; e() is the sentinel test -> isValid ;
#   f() returns the table index p -> getIndex ; static b(dx,dy) computes that index -> toIndex ;
#   static a(index) / a(dx,dy) are the two lookups -> fromIndex / of.
#   c()/d() return the in-tile boundary fractions (dx=-1 -> 0.1, 0 -> 0.5, +1 -> 0.9) that
#   WorldSimulator adds to a tile centre when stepping to the edge -> getEdgeOffsetX/Y.
# NeighborTable: private static Neighbor[16] plus its synthetic accessor -> getTable.
# RoadTile: static a(RoadMask, boolean) is the factory used by both WorldSerializer and the editor
#   b() and a(boolean) are deliberately left unnamed: the flag is set for '#' but not for '+' in
#   the map format (WorldSerializer) and only selects a different sprite row in GameScreen; there is
#   no evidence yet whether it means paved/primary/dirty, so it stays obfuscated (see 25 s3).
# RoadMask: the 16 constants are bit combinations of the road connection mask (values()[ordinal|1]
#   in WorldSerializer); their individual meaning needs a tile-graphics mapping, left unnamed.
# No member here is referenced by name (no reflection, no named persistence: RoadMask/ordinal and
#   the Neighbor index are stored, not names), so renaming cannot change save data.
